title: Beyond Good and Evil
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
public_title: Do gadgets really make you happy?
hook: You chase happiness buying the newest gadgets.

sections.title: Story
sections.narration: You chase happiness buying the newest gadgets. Centuries ago philosophers warned that novelty blinds true fulfillment. In 2000, Deci and Ryan surveyed students and found about 30% of well‑being came from autonomy. Nietzsche said herd seeks comfort, not growth. The result? 2015 research showed intrinsic‑goal people reported about 20% higher happiness. Why still buy the latest tech? Because the herd instinct still pushes us, just as Nietzsche warned. That's it. So next time you reach for a gadget, remember autonomy wins. You chase happiness buying the newest gadgets.
